components.label: Project Snapshot
components.summary: Compact role, audience, project type, and tool summary used near the top of standard case-study pages.
components.best_for: Giving hiring managers fast context before they enter the full project story.
components.avoid_when: A custom experience already has a stronger purpose-built overview.

components.label: Tabbed / Switcher Interaction
components.summary: Keyboard-accessible tabs that let visitors switch between tightly related views without lengthening the page.
components.best_for: Approach vs. capabilities, process vs. tools, scenario states, or other paired/multi-view content.
components.avoid_when: The content should be read sequentially or each option needs its own URL/state.

components.label: Detail Card Grid
components.summary: Reusable card-based detail section for concise parallel ideas, decisions, or deliverables.
components.best_for: Three-to-six items that benefit from quick scanning and equal visual weight.
components.avoid_when: The items form a sequence or require row/column comparison.

components.label: Process / Flow
components.summary: Grouped step flow for showing a process, workflow, handoff, or development sequence.
components.best_for: Ordered work where sequence and grouping matter.
components.avoid_when: The items are independent rather than sequential.

components.label: Comparison Table
components.summary: Structured table treatment for true side-by-side comparison or matrix-style evidence.
components.best_for: Content that is clearer when values are compared across consistent columns.
components.avoid_when: The page would become easier to read as cards or prose, especially on mobile.

components.label: Evidence / Artifact Grid
components.summary: Conditional artifact area for screenshots, video, documents, downloads, embeds, code, or other public-safe evidence.
components.best_for: Showing real outputs without turning the case study into an asset dump.
components.avoid_when: No public-safe artifact materially strengthens the story.

components.label: Related Work Cards
components.summary: Contextual project-to-project cards generated from structured related_work relationships.
components.best_for: Showing a meaningful adjacent capability, workflow, or companion project.
components.avoid_when: The connection is weak, repetitive, or only exists to create more links.

components.label: Accordion / Disclosure
components.summary: Progressive disclosure pattern for optional detail that should not dominate the initial scan.
components.best_for: Warnings, supporting detail, grouped examples, FAQs, or long secondary explanations.
components.avoid_when: The hidden content is essential to understanding the primary story.

components.label: Decision / Scenario Practice
components.summary: Interactive decision practice where a visitor evaluates information, makes a choice, and sees feedback or consequences.
components.best_for: Demonstrating scenario-based learning, sales judgment, qualification, or branching practice.
components.avoid_when: A static explanation would communicate the work just as well.

components.label: Motion Graphic / Animated Visual
components.summary: Purpose-built motion or animated visual used to explain a concept, product position, workflow, or transition.
components.best_for: Concepts where movement clarifies sequence, relationship, positioning, or transformation.
components.avoid_when: Animation is decorative and does not improve comprehension.
